description: Interpolating the null keyword next to other template parts is an error
notes: The spec makes an interpolation an error when its value can't be converted to string, but null converts to any type (Conversion of Null Values), and it says a template with an element of the dynamic pseudo-type, which includes the null keyword, produces an unknown string. hashicorp/hcl reports an error for any null part in TemplateExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression_template.go).
